about: A photo and file manager that organizes files with tags instead of folders.

prs.title: Search filters apply only to their own word
prs.broken: A filter like filetype:jpeg also applied to the words after it, so "filetype:jpeg vacation" found nothing and some exclusions stopped working.
prs.changed: A word without a filter is always a tag search again, whatever comes before it.
prs.matters: Searches give the same results no matter the order the words are typed in.
